issues.requirement_quote: The collision avoidance system ... transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met, such as detecting pedestrians (`pedestrian_detected`), the rear distance being less than 5 meters with a velocity over 30 km/h (`dist_to_rear<5 & vel>30`), or the front distance being less than 15 meters in highway mode or 10 meters in urban mode.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The event and its consumer transition are declared and structurally complete; only operational reachability is refuted.
issues.title: Collision Activation Consumer Is Unreachable

issues.basis: Source transition tr_0027 maps to closed transition:line:87 with exact endpoint state refs.
issues.observed: Exact transition:line:87 exists with the required endpoints.
issues.reason: The exact deactive-to-active endpoint pair exists in the closed model, so the endpoint contract itself is satisfied. It is included here only as an audit observation and should not be treated as a violation.
issues.requirement_quote: It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met, such as detecting pedestrians (`pedestrian_detected`), the rear distance being less than 5 meters with a velocity over 30 km/h (`dist_to_rear<5 & vel>30`), or the front distance being less than 15 meters in highway mode or 10 meters in urban mode.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The exact endpoint transition is present.
issues.title: Collision Activation Transition Is Structurally Present

issues.basis: NL6 termination contract; source transition tr_0009/tr_0011/tr_0012 and FCSTM transitions transition:line:73, transition:line:75, transition:line:76, transition:line:90; exact target FinishState is state:FinishState:line:21, while active HighwayMode has continuing outbound behavior.
issues.expected: HighwayMode must terminate by reaching a stable FinishState on the auto_finished=true completion path.
issues.observed: HighwayMode has reachable continuation to UrbanMode, and the closed hierarchy retains outbound completion-related behavior around FinishState; the finite endpoint edge alone does not close termination.
issues.reason: The required FinishState endpoint exists, but the exact closed model also gives HighwayMode an outbound transition to UrbanMode and FinishState outbound transitions to the enclosing completion path. Therefore endpoint existence does not establish stable termination of HighwayMode.
issues.requirement_quote: The HighwayMode ends when the system transitions to FinishState, triggered by the `auto_finished=true` condition.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The explicit HighwayMode-to-FinishState transition exists, and the supplied finite facts do not provide a complete temporal proof that every execution remains in completion; this candidate therefore records the semantic termination gap rather than claiming a stronger finite verdict.
issues.title: Highway termination is not stable

issues.basis: NL10 termination contract; source requires UrbanMode to terminate at FinishState; closed model uses transition:line:56 and transition:line:58 to emit completion tokens, then transition:line:71/72/74 and transition:line:75/76/90 provide continued enclosing behavior.
issues.expected: UrbanMode must terminate by reaching a stable FinishState when auto_finished=true is satisfied.
issues.observed: UrbanMode has reachable descendant-to-completion exits whose route-control effects feed further enclosing transitions; the supplied topology does not provide a stable terminal boundary for the required UrbanMode termination.
issues.reason: The closed model contains completion transitions from UrbanMode descendants, but it also routes completion tokens through HighwayMode and retains cross-mode continuation. The designated FinishState is not a stable termination boundary for the UrbanMode obligation.
issues.requirement_quote: The system exits the UrbanMode state by transitioning to FinishState once `auto_finished=true` is satisfied.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source and closed model both contain completion-directed transitions, and no finite trace summary proves a specific post-completion cycle; the candidate is limited to the unsupported stable-termination property.
issues.title: Urban termination is not stable

issues.basis: NL12-derived containment contract plus NL12 activation obligation; exact source/model state mapping binds collision_avoidance_active to state:collision_avoidance_active:line:85, and inspection/verify facts mark it unreachable. The candidate preserves the supplied contract's containment semantic key and reports the distinct behavioral gap only against the existing derived contract.
issues.expected: collision_avoidance_active must be an operational state within the collision avoidance system scope.
issues.observed: The state is structurally contained under CollisionAvoidance but is unreachable from root; its activation consumer transition:line:87 has no reachable consumer state or transition.
issues.reason: The active state is declared and correctly contained, but the complete closed-model reachability facts show that CollisionAvoidance and both of its child states are unreachable from the top-level initial entry. The behavioral consequence is that the required active behavior cannot occur operationally.
issues.requirement_quote: collision_avoidance_deactive and collision_avoidance_active must be states within the collision avoidance system scope.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The exact containment relation is present in both source and closed model; only the operational reachability consequence is defective, which cannot be represented as a stronger containment predicate without changing the contract property.
issues.title: Collision avoidance active state is unreachable
